extracted.name: Sour Cream Dressing
extracted.description: This sour cream salad dressing has a touch of sweetness and a hint of mustard and garlic. It’s deliciously creamy on a crisp green salad.
instruction_lines: Whisk oil, vinegar, sour cream, salt, mustard, sugar, parsley, garlic, and pepper together in a bowl. Refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.
